turns.question: What is HDFC Bank trading at?
turns.answer: HDFC Bank (NSE: **HDFCBANK**) is trading at **₹702.75**, down **₹8.70 (1.22%)** versus its previous close. Quote time: **7 October 2026, 3:15 p.m. IST**.

turns.question: Iska P/E kitna hai aur kya yeh zyada hai?
turns.answer:
HDFC Bank ka **trailing P/E lagbhag 15.4** hai—matlab market har ₹1 ke pichhle saal ke profit ke liye kareeb ₹15.40 de raha hai. **Forward P/E lagbhag 11.2** hai, jo aane wale profit ke estimates par aadharit hai.

Yeh P/E apne aap mein “zyada” ya “kam” nahi batata. Bank ke liye iska matlab samajhne ko peer banks ke P/E, profit ki growth, loan quality aur valuation ke historical range se tulna karni hoti hai. Forward P/E estimates par nirbhar hai, aur actual profit alag ho sakta hai.

**What this means for you:** P/E ek valuation ka sanket hai, akela faisla karne ka paimana nahi. Nazar explains; the decision is yours. This isn't investment advice.
